About Us

Our history

The Youth Empowerment Network(YEN) was founded in 2024 in Pretoria, South Africa, with the goal of addressing youth unemployment. Over the years, YEN has connected thousand of young people with internships, learnerships, and job opportunities, building strong partnerships with companies and sponsors nationwide.

Our Mission

Our mission is to empower young people by providing access to meaningful employment opportunities, skills development, and mentorship, ensuring that they can build sustainable careers and contribute positively to society.

Our Vision

The YEN's vision it to become South Africa's leadeing youth empowerment platform, bridging the gap between education and employment, and creating a future where every young person has the chance to thrive.
